transcript: When you feel lonely most of your life, when you do not really have a strong circle, when it feels like people do not truly see you, it starts to become your normal. You speak and no one really listens. You send a message and no one replies. You show up but somehow still feel invisible, like you are there but not really included. And after a while you learn to live with that feeling. You tell yourself, this is just how life is for me. This is just my place. This is just my normal. But deep inside there is always one small hope. You think, maybe not every day, but at least on my birthday it will feel different. At least on that one day someone will make me feel special. Someone will remember me. Someone will reach out, talk to me, want to spend time with me. And remind me that I matter. Because even the people who act strong all year still want to feel seen at least once.
